nav.label: Portal
nav.waitingCount: {count, plural, one {# review waiting for you} other {# reviews waiting for you}}

preview.banner: You are seeing what clients of {client} see. Nothing you do here is recorded as the client.
preview.pageIntro: Open the portal exactly as one of your clients sees it: only the projects, updates, deliverables, reviews and requests shared with them. The preview is read-only — you can’t submit requests or record a decision on their behalf.
preview.noClientsHint: Create a client account and turn the portal on for one of their projects first.
preview.projectsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No portal projects} one {# project in the portal} other {# projects in the portal}}
preview.notAllowed: The client portal is the workspace for client contacts.
preview.notAllowedHint: Owners and admins can preview it; everyone else works in the main app.

home.intro: Everything {org} has shared with you, in one place.
home.needsYouHint: Reviews and questions waiting on your reply.
home.allClearHint: We’ll show reviews and questions here as soon as they come up.
home.projectsHint: Progress counts only the work shared with you.
home.noProjectsHint: When {org} shares a project with you, it appears here.
home.noRequestsHint: Ask for a change, report a problem or start something new.

project.onlyShared: You see the milestones, updates, files and documents the team has shared with you.

requests.title: Requests
requests.intro: Ask for a change, report a problem, or start something new. We’ll reply in the request itself.
requests.newIntro: Tell us what you need. The more detail you give, the fewer questions we’ll have.
requests.emptyHint: Your first request will show up here with its status.
requests.chooseForm: What kind of request is this?
requests.fieldTitleHint: One line, like “Add the autumn menu to the site”.
requests.fieldDetailsHint: Anything that helps us: pages involved, deadlines, examples.
requests.submitted_toast: Request sent. We’ll be in touch here.
requests.noFormsHint: {org} hasn’t opened a request form for you yet. Email your contact there instead.
requests.conversationHint: Questions from the team and your answers. Only you and {org} can see this.
requests.needsInfoHint: Reply below and we’ll pick it up right away.

approvals.title: Reviews
approvals.intro: Work waiting for your decision, and the decisions you’ve already made.
approvals.emptyHint: When the team needs your approval, it will appear here.
approvals.noPreview: This file can’t be shown in the browser
approvals.noPreviewHint: Download it to take a look, then come back to decide.
approvals.decideHint: Tell us where this stands. If something needs changing, say what — the team sees your note.
approvals.commentRequiredHint: Required when you ask for changes or reject.
approvals.closedHint: No further decisions can be recorded on it.
approvals.supersededTitle: A newer version replaced this round
approvals.supersededHint: Open the latest round to decide on the current version.
approvals.notReviewer: You’re not a reviewer on this
approvals.notReviewerHint: You can see it because it’s shared with you, but only the named reviewers can decide.
approvals.discussionHint: Notes between you and the team about this review.
approvals.emptyOthersHint: Reviews you have already decided on, and reviews for other people, appear here.

deliverables.title: Deliverables
deliverables.intro: Every file the team has shared with you, newest first.
deliverables.emptyHint: Files the team shares with you appear here, grouped by project.

updates.title: Updates
updates.intro: Status updates the team has shared with you.
updates.emptyHint: When the team posts an update for you, it shows up here.

file.noPreview: No preview for this file type
file.noPreviewHint: Download it to open it on your computer.
